column2: The initial plan was simple, but it changed many times later.
column3: 最初的計畫很簡單，但後來改了很多次。
column5: initial 的 ini 像「一你」，一開始你先出場，就是最初的

column2: Chess is an intellectual game that trains your thinking skills.
column3: 西洋棋是一種訓練思考能力的智力遊戲。
column5: intellect 是腦力，加 -ual 變形容詞：用腦力的

column2: She is an intelligent girl who learns new things very quickly.
column3: 她是個聰明的女孩，學新東西非常快。
column5: 「因貼利根」：因為貼近道理，腦筋就靈光

column2: The intense heat of the desert made everyone stay inside at noon.
column3: 沙漠的酷熱讓大家中午都待在室內。
column5: in 向內 + tense 繃緊：往內繃緊到極點，就是強烈

column2: He took an intensive English course before going to study in Canada.
column3: 他去加拿大唸書前上了一門英文密集課程。
column5: intense 強烈，加 -ive 就是把很多課塞進短時間

column2: The two sisters are so intimate that they share every secret.
column3: 這對姊妹非常親密，連每個祕密都分享。
column5: 「因提悶」：兩人貼得很近，連悄悄話都不悶在心裡

column2: Tom is a junior member of the team, so he often learns from others.
column3: 湯姆是團隊裡資淺的成員，所以常向別人學習。
column5: junior 像「J 你兒」，年紀比你小的後輩
column8: 年紀較輕的；資淺的；三年級(生)的

column2: Mia is keen on drawing and spends every weekend at the art club.
column3: 米雅熱愛畫畫，每個週末都泡在美術社。
column5: keen 像「金」：金色的眼睛看得準，心也熱切

column2: It is lawful to ride a bike on this road, but not on the highway.
column3: 在這條路上騎腳踏車是合法的，但高速公路上不行。
column5: law 法律 + ful 充滿：滿滿都是法律允許的

column2: The lean boy ran fast, but he needed to eat more to grow stronger.
column3: 那個精瘦的男孩跑得很快，但他需要多吃一點才會更強壯。
column5: lean 是「瘦」，也可想成「靠」：瘦得要靠牆站

column2: We took a leisurely walk along the river after dinner.
column3: 晚餐後我們沿著河邊悠閒地散步。
column5: leisure 是閒暇，加 ly 讓動作也慢慢來

column2: Our teacher asked us to write a short literary essay about spring.
column3: 老師要我們寫一篇關於春天的短篇文學作品。
column5: literature 是文學，literary 就是屬於文學的

column2: The weather was lousy, so our picnic turned into a movie day at home.
column3: 天氣糟透了，我們的野餐就改成在家看電影。
column5: 想像一個「老是」下雨的日子，真討厭又糟糕

column2: The loyal dog waited at the station for its owner every evening.
column3: 那隻忠心的狗每天傍晚都在車站等主人。
column5: 「若有」難，我都在：loyal 像「若有 o」，永遠不離開

column2: Families gather for dinner on the first day of the lunar new year.
column3: 農曆新年的第一天，家人會團聚吃飯。
column5: luna 是月亮，lunar 就是和月亮有關的

column2: They stayed in a luxurious hotel with a pool on the roof.
column3: 他們住在屋頂有游泳池的豪華飯店。
column5: luxury 是奢華，luxurious 讓人想說「樂死了」

column2: A magnetic strip on the card lets the machine read your information.
column3: 卡片上的磁條讓機器能讀取你的資料。
column5: magnet 是磁鐵，加 -ic 變成有磁力的

column2: We were amazed by the magnificent view of the mountains at sunrise.
column3: 我們被日出時壯麗的山景震懾了。
column5: magni 是大，magnificent 就是大到讓人驚嘆

column2: My uncle drives a car with manual gears, so he must use his left hand.
column3: 我叔叔開手排車，所以必須用左手換檔。
column5: manu 是手：manual 就是用手來操作

column2: The elevator has a maximum load of eight people.
column3: 這部電梯最多可載八個人。
column5: max 就是最大，像把音量開到「馬克思」麥

column2: The old clock stopped because a mechanical part inside was broken.
column3: 那座老鐘停了，因為裡面一個機械零件壞了。
column5: mechanic 是修車師傅，mechanical 就是機械的

column2: Our trip to the zoo was so memorable that I still talk about it.
column3: 我們的動物園之旅太難忘了，我到現在還在說。
column5: memor 是記憶，-able 是可以：值得被記住

column2: Visitors placed flowers at the memorial hall to honor the heroes.
column3: 訪客在紀念館獻花，向英雄致敬。
column5: memor 記憶：為了記住某人而建的

column2: It was a mere scratch, so the nurse only put on a small bandage.
column3: 那只是一道小擦傷，所以護理師只貼了小繃帶。
column4: a mere child (僅僅是個孩子)
column5: mere 像「米爾」：只有一點點米，不多

column2: His desk is so messy that he cannot find his pencil.
column3: 他的書桌太亂了，找不到自己的鉛筆。
column5: mess 是亂七八糟，加 y 就是亂糟糟的樣子

column2: You need a minimum of ten points to pass the quiz.
column3: 你至少要拿十分才能通過小考。
column5: mini 是迷你小：minimum 就是小到不能再小

column2: The lost puppy looked cold and miserable in the rain.
column3: 那隻走失的小狗在雨中看起來又冷又可憐。
column5: 「迷死了路」的小狗好可憐，所以是悽慘的

column2: She gave a modest smile when everyone praised her singing.
column3: 大家稱讚她的歌聲時，她謙虛地笑了笑。
column5: 「謀得死」：謀事得體，不誇張也不過頭

column2: The club holds a monthly meeting on the first Friday.
column3: 社團每月第一個星期五開一次會。
column5: month 是月，加 ly 就是每個月一次

column2: After the storm, the muddy path was too slippery to walk on.
column3: 暴風雨後，泥濘的小路滑得無法行走。
column5: mud 是泥巴，加 y 就是滿是泥巴的

column2: The accident caused multiple injuries, so several ambulances arrived.
column3: 這起意外造成多人受傷，所以來了好幾輛救護車。
column5: multi 是很多：多多的選項放在一起

column2: A mysterious light appeared over the lake every midnight.
column3: 每到午夜，湖面上都會出現一道神祕的光。
column5: mystery 是謎，加 -ious 就是充滿謎團的

column2: Because he is nearsighted, he cannot read the board without glasses.
column3: 因為他近視，沒戴眼鏡就看不清黑板。
column5: near 近 + sighted 看得見：只看得見近處

column2: The charity gives warm coats to needy families every winter.
column3: 這個慈善團體每年冬天提供保暖外套給貧困家庭。
column5: need 需要，加 y 就是什麼都很需要的人

column2: A nuclear power plant makes electricity from the energy inside atoms.
column3: 核能發電廠利用原子內的能量來產生電力。
column5: nucleus 是核心，nuclear 就是核心的、原子核的

column2: The obedient child always follows the rules at school.
column3: 那個聽話的孩子在學校總是遵守規定。
column5: 「喔必爹」：喔，一定要聽爹的話，就是順從

column2: I have an occasional cup of coffee, but not every day.
column3: 我偶爾喝杯咖啡，但不是每天。
column5: occasion 是場合：只在某些場合才出現

column2: His joke was offensive, so many classmates asked him to say sorry.
column3: 他的玩笑很冒犯人，所以很多同學要他道歉。
column5: offend 是得罪人，-ive 讓它變成會得罪人的

column2: We had an oral test where the teacher asked us questions out loud.
column3: 我們有一場口試，老師大聲問我們問題。
column5: 「歐囉」：口對著人說「歐囉」，就是口頭的

column2: She won a prize for her outstanding work in science.
column3: 她因為在科學上的傑出表現而得獎。
column5: out 出來 + stand 站：站在人群之外，特別突出
